title: Bavarian Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert featuring layers of flaky pastry, sweet apples, and a hint of cinnamon.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, sugar, and cinnamon. Mix well to combine.
Spread the apple mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the 1-inch border over the apple mixture, then fold in the sides and roll the strudel into a tight log.
Place the strudel on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, seam-side down.
Brush the top of the strudel with the melted butter.
Bake the strudel for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the strudel from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes.
Slice the strudel into individual portions and serve warm.
